topics.topic: Introduction to Technical Drawing: Equipment, standards, paper sizes, and line types
learningObjectives: Identify standard drafting instruments (T-square, set-squares, compasses, scales)
Distinguish between ISO paper sizes (A0 to A4) and correct board mounting
Draw BS 8888 standard line types (continuous thick, continuous thin, hidden detail, center lines)

topics.topic: Board Practice: Title block, lettering, dimensioning principles, and border lines
learningObjectives: Construct standard layout border lines (10mm margins) and standard school title blocks
Practice vertical single-stroke Gothic lettering of numerals and capital letters
Apply standard engineering dimensioning rules (projection lines, arrowheads, leader lines)

topics.topic: Geometrical Construction: Bisecting straight lines, arcs, and constructing specific angles
learningObjectives: Bisect straight lines and circular arcs accurately using compasses
Construct angles of 15°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 75°, 90°, and 105° without protractors
Divide lines into proportional parts and equal segments geometrically

topics.topic: Triangles: Classification, properties, and constructing inscribed/circumscribed circles
learningObjectives: Classify triangles according to sides (equilateral, isosceles, scalene) and angles
Construct triangles given base, altitude, and base angles
Inscribe, circumscribe, and escribe circles to given triangles geometrically

topics.topic: Quadrilaterals: Squares, rectangles, parallelograms, rhombuses, and trapeziums
learningObjectives: Construct squares and rectangles given diagonals and side dimensions
Construct parallelograms and rhombuses given side lengths and included angles
Determine diagonals and internal geometric properties of quadrilaterals

topics.topic: Polygons: Regular pentagons, hexagons, heptagons, and octagons
learningObjectives: Construct regular hexagons given across-flats or across-corners measurements
Construct regular polygons using the general method (dividing diameter into equal parts)
Determine interior and exterior angles of convex polygons

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Studio Drafting Critique
learningObjectives: Assess pupil drafting accuracy, line contrast, and title block craftsmanship
Perform timed construction drills on polygon circumscription
Address individual errors in pencil sharpening, compass play, and smudging

topics.topic: Circles and Tangency: Constructing internal and external tangents to two circles
learningObjectives: Define terms: radius, diameter, chord, quadrant, sector, and segment
Construct tangents to a single circle from external points
Construct common internal and external tangents (open/crossed belts) between unequal circles

topics.topic: Tangential Arcs and Blending Curves in Engineering Components
learningObjectives: Blend circular arcs to straight lines and intersecting corners smoothly
Construct internal and external blending arcs between two existing circles
Draft standard spanner profiles and machine brackets utilizing tangency principles

topics.topic: Enlargement and Reduction of Plane Figures: Linear and areal ratios
learningObjectives: Enlarge and reduce irregular plane polygons using the radial/pole method
Enlarge figures using the grid/coordinate method to designated linear proportions
Calculate ratios of areas for geometrically similar plane figures

topics.topic: Introduction to Pictorial Drawing: Oblique and Isometric projection fundamentals
learningObjectives: Differentiate between isometric axes (30°/30°) and oblique cabinet/cavalier axes (45°)
Construct isometric boxes and locate points on shaped solid blocks
Draw simple stepped blocks in oblique and isometric projection

topics.topic: Comprehensive Termly Technical Drawing Revision & Studio Portfolio Review
learningObjectives: Synthesize all geometric construction protocols from lines to isometric primitives
Evaluate student drawing sheets against WAEC/NECO marking schemes
Rehearse speed drafting techniques under simulated examination conditions

topics.topic: Terminal Examination and Board Practical Assessment
learningObjectives: Examine technical drawing theory and practical board execution
Score drawing sheets for neatness, linework precision, and dimensional accuracy
Record standardized termly grades for broadsheet compilation
